blocks.text: O'zbekchada «Ertaga erta turishim **kerak** — ish soat yettida boshlanadi», «Piyoda borishga **majbur bo'ldik**» deganda zarurat o'zimizdan emas, **tashqi sharoitdan** keladi: ish tartibi, qoida, vaziyat. Ingliz tilida bunday zarurat uchun ko'pincha **have to** ishlatiladi: I **have to** get up early. **have to** ma'nosi bo'yicha **must** ga yaqin (→ 31-dars), lekin grammatikasi boshqa: u modal fe'l emas, oddiy fe'l kabi tuslanadi.

**have to** — Present Simple dagi oddiy fe'l kabi (→ 5–7-darslar): he / she / it bilan **has to**, inkor va savolda **do / does** yordamchi fe'li keladi. Qisqa javoblar ham shunday: Do you have to work today? — Yes, I **do**. / No, I **don't**. Undan keyin fe'l doim oddiy shaklda: has to **go** («has to goes» emas).

items.text: My brother **has to** take two buses to get to work.
items.translation: Akam ishga borish uchun ikkita avtobusga **o'tirishga majbur**.

items.text: **Do** you **have to** wear a uniform? — Yes, I **do**.

blocks.text: **must** ning o'tgan zamon shakli yo'q, shuning uchun o'tmishdagi zarurat doim **had to** bilan aytiladi: I **had to** wait — «Kutishga majbur bo'ldim», «Kutishim kerak edi». Inkori — **didn't have to** («...ishim shart bo'lmadi»), savoli — **Did** you **have to** ...? Kelajakda — **will have to**: You**'ll have to** wait — «Kutishingizga to'g'ri keladi».

items.text: The bus didn't come, so I **had to** walk home.
items.translation: Avtobus kelmadi, shuning uchun uyga piyoda **borishga majbur bo'ldim**.

items.text: We **didn't have to** pay for the drinks.
Sorry, you**'ll have to** wait a few minutes.
items.translation: Kechirasiz, bir necha daqiqa **kutishingizga to'g'ri keladi**.

blocks.text: **don't have to** = **don't need to** (31-dars): zarurat yo'q, xohlasangiz qilasiz. You **don't have to** come — «Kelishingiz shart emas». Bu **mustn't** («mumkin emas») bilan umuman bir xil emas! Darak gapda must va have to ma'nosi yaqin, inkorda esa butunlay boshqa: You **mustn't** tell him — «Unga aytmang», You **don't have to** tell him — «Unga aytishingiz shart emas (o'zingiz bilasiz)».

items.text: Lola **doesn't have to** cook today — it's her husband's turn.
items.translation: Lola bugun **ovqat qilishi shart emas** — bugun erining navbati.

items.text: You **mustn't** park here, but you **don't have to** pay on the next street.
items.translation: Bu yerda mashina **qo'yish mumkin emas**, keyingi ko'chada esa **to'lash shart emas**.

blocks.text: Darak gapda farq nozik. **must** — so'zlovchining o'z fikri, ichki zarurat: I **must** call Grandma — «Buvimga qo'ng'iroq qilishim kerak (o'zim shunday deb bilaman)». **have to** — tashqi sabab: qoida, ish, boshqa odamning talabi: I **have to** call my boss — «Boshlig'imga qo'ng'iroq qilishim kerak (u so'radi)». Kundalik so'zlashuvda inglizlar **have to** ni ko'proq ishlatadi; **must** esa rasmiy qoidalar va kuchli shaxsiy fikr uchun.

Britaniyada so'zlashuvda **have got to** ham eshitiladi: I**'ve got to** go = I **have to** go («Ketishim kerak»). have got haqida → 9-dars. Yozuvda va savol-inkorda oddiy **have to** ishlatgan ma'qul.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «He have to work.» → **He has to work.**; «She has to goes.» → **She has to go.**; «I musted go.» / «I must go yesterday.» → **I had to go yesterday.**; «Did you had to wait?» → **Did you have to wait?** (did dan keyin `have`); «Do you must ...?» → **Do you have to ...?**; «You don't have to smoke here.» (ma'nosi «mumkin emas» bo'lsa) → **You mustn't smoke here.**
Eslab qolish: «majburman», «...ga to'g'ri keladi» — **have to**; o'tmishda — **had to**, «majbur bo'ldim». Inkorda ehtiyot bo'ling: **don't have to** = «shart emas», **mustn't** = «mumkin emas».

items: **have to / has to** + fe'l — tashqi sababli zarurat: I **have to** work. She **has to** wait.
**had to** — o'tmishda (must ning o'tgan zamoni ham shu): We **had to** run.
**don't / doesn't / didn't have to** — shart emas: You **don't have to** stay.
Savol — **do / does / did** bilan: **Do** you **have to** go? — Yes, I **do**.
**must** — ichki zarurat va qoidalar; **mustn't** (mumkin emas) ≠ **don't have to** (shart emas).

examples.title: **have to** / **has to**: rules and situations
examples.description: Tashqi sababli zarurat: ish tartibi, qoida, vaziyat. **have to** — I / you / we / they, **has to** — he / she / it.

sentences.text: I **have to** get up at six every day because my work starts at seven.
sentences.translation: Har kuni soat oltida **turishim kerak**, chunki ishim yettida boshlanadi.

sentences.text: Nurses often **have to** work at night.
sentences.translation: Hamshiralar ko'pincha tunda **ishlashga majbur**.

sentences.text: Aziz works at a hotel, so he **has to** wear a uniform.
sentences.translation: Aziz mehmonxonada ishlaydi, shuning uchun u forma **kiyishi shart**.

sentences.text: My sister **has to** take her medicine three times a day.
sentences.translation: Opam kuniga uch mahal dori **ichishi kerak**.

sentences.text: In this building we **have to** use the stairs — the lift is broken.
sentences.translation: Bu binoda zinadan **foydalanishga majburmiz** — lift buzuq.

sentences.text: Bekzod lives far from the university, so he **has to** take two buses.
sentences.translation: Bekzod universitetdan uzoqda yashaydi, shuning uchun ikkita avtobusga **o'tirishga majbur**.

sentences.text: Emma's car is being repaired, so she **has to** walk to work this week.
sentences.translation: Emmaning mashinasi ta'mirlanmoqda, shuning uchun u bu hafta ishga piyoda **borishga majbur**.

sentences.text: In most countries people **have to** pay tax on their salary.
sentences.translation: Ko'p davlatlarda odamlar maoshidan soliq **to'lashi shart**.

sentences.text: Sorry, I **have to** go now — my bus leaves in five minutes.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, hozir **ketishim kerak** — avtobusim besh daqiqadan keyin jo'naydi.

sentences.text: When you drive in central London, you **have to** pay a special charge.
sentences.translation: Londonning markazida mashina haydasangiz, maxsus to'lov **to'lashingiz shart**.

examples.title: **had to**: it was necessary in the past
examples.description: O'tmishdagi zarurat — **had to** («...ishga majbur bo'ldim», «...ishim kerak edi»). **must** ning o'tgan zamoni yo'q, uning o'rnida ham **had to**.

sentences.text: I **had to** work late yesterday, so I missed dinner.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechgacha **ishlashga majbur bo'ldim**, shuning uchun kechki ovqatga ulgurmadim.

sentences.text: The road was closed, and we **had to** go another way.
sentences.translation: Yo'l yopiq edi, boshqa yo'ldan **borishga majbur bo'ldik**.

sentences.text: Madina lost her keys and **had to** wait for her husband outside.
sentences.translation: Madina kalitlarini yo'qotib qo'ydi va erini tashqarida **kutishga majbur bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: When my grandfather was young, he **had to** walk five kilometres to school.
sentences.translation: Bobom yoshligida maktabga besh kilometr piyoda **yurishga majbur bo'lgan**.

sentences.text: Last week Tom was ill, so he **had to** stay in bed.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta Tom kasal edi, shuning uchun to'shakda **yotishga majbur bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: The flight was cancelled, and the passengers **had to** spend the night at the airport.
sentences.translation: Reys bekor qilindi va yo'lovchilar tunni aeroportda **o'tkazishga majbur bo'lishdi**.

sentences.text: We **had to** pay extra for our heavy suitcases.
sentences.translation: Og'ir chamadonlarimiz uchun qo'shimcha **to'lashga majbur bo'ldik**.

sentences.text: The lift wasn't working, so Sarah **had to** carry the boxes up to the fifth floor.
sentences.translation: Lift ishlamayotgan edi, shuning uchun Sara qutilarni beshinchi qavatga **ko'tarib chiqishga majbur bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: At my old school we **had to** wear a white shirt every Monday.
sentences.translation: Eski maktabimda har dushanba oq ko'ylak **kiyishimiz shart edi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod's phone died, so he **had to** borrow mine to call his mum.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning telefoni o'chib qoldi, shuning uchun oyisiga qo'ng'iroq qilish uchun menikini **olib turishga majbur bo'ldi**.

examples.title: **don't have to** / **doesn't have to**: not necessary
examples.description: **don't have to** (he/she — **doesn't have to**, o'tmishda — **didn't have to**) = «...ish shart emas», «...ishga hojat yo'q». Taqiq emas!

sentences.text: You **don't have to** come with me — I can go alone.
sentences.translation: Men bilan **borishing shart emas** — yolg'iz bora olaman.

sentences.text: It's Saturday tomorrow, so the children **don't have to** go to school.
sentences.translation: Ertaga shanba, shuning uchun bolalar maktabga **borishi shart emas**.

sentences.text: Sarah works from home, so she **doesn't have to** travel to the office.
sentences.translation: Sara uydan ishlaydi, shuning uchun ofisga **qatnashi shart emas**.

sentences.text: We **don't have to** cook tonight — Aziz is bringing pizza.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **ovqat qilishimiz shart emas** — Aziz pitsa olib kelyapti.

sentences.text: Entry to the museum is free, so visitors **don't have to** buy tickets.
sentences.translation: Muzeyga kirish bepul, shuning uchun tashrif buyuruvchilar chipta **olishlari shart emas**.

sentences.text: My father is retired now, so he **doesn't have to** get up early.
sentences.translation: Dadam endi nafaqada, shuning uchun erta **turishi shart emas**.

sentences.text: I **didn't have to** wait long — the doctor saw me at once.
sentences.translation: Uzoq **kutishimga to'g'ri kelmadi** — shifokor meni darrov qabul qildi.

sentences.text: Thanks, but you **don't have to** help me with the dishes.
sentences.translation: Rahmat, lekin idish yuvishda menga **yordam berishingiz shart emas**.

sentences.text: Small children **don't have to** pay for the bus.
sentences.translation: Kichik bolalar avtobus uchun **to'lashi shart emas**.

sentences.text: Last summer Madina passed all her exams early, so she **didn't have to** take any in September.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yozda Madina barcha imtihonlarini erta topshirdi, shuning uchun sentyabrda birortasini ham **topshirishi shart bo'lmadi**.

examples.title: Questions: **Do you have to ...?** **Did you have to ...?**
examples.description: Savol **do / does / did** bilan: **Do** you **have to** ...? — «...ishingiz kerakmi?». Qisqa javob: Yes, I **do**. / No, he **doesn't**. / Yes, we **did**.

sentences.text: **Do** you **have to** work tomorrow? — No, I **don't**. It's my day off.
sentences.translation: Ertaga **ishlashingiz kerakmi**? — Yo'q, **kerak emas**. Dam olish kunim.

sentences.text: **Does** Aziz **have to** wear a tie at work? — Yes, he **does**.
sentences.translation: Aziz ishda galstuk **taqishi shartmi**? — Ha, **shart**.

sentences.text: What time **do** you **have to** be at the station? — At half past nine.
sentences.translation: Vokzalda soat nechada **bo'lishingiz kerak**? — To'qqiz yarimda.

sentences.text: **Did** you **have to** show your passport at the hotel? — Yes, we **did**.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonada pasportingizni **ko'rsatishingizga to'g'ri keldimi**? — Ha, **to'g'ri keldi**.

sentences.text: Why **does** Emma **have to** leave so early? — She's got a train to catch.
sentences.translation: Nega Emma bunchalik erta **ketishi kerak**? — U poyezdga ulgurishi kerak.

sentences.text: How long **did** Bekzod **have to** stay in hospital? — Just two days.
sentences.translation: Bekzod kasalxonada qancha **yotishiga to'g'ri keldi**? — Bor-yo'g'i ikki kun.

sentences.text: **Do** I **have to** pay now, or can I pay later? — You can pay later.
sentences.translation: Hozir **to'lashim kerakmi** yoki keyin to'lasam ham bo'ladimi? — Keyin to'lashingiz mumkin.

sentences.text: **Did** the students **have to** write an essay in the exam? — No, they **didn't**.
sentences.translation: Talabalar imtihonda insho **yozishlari kerak bo'ldimi**? — Yo'q, **kerak bo'lmadi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza, how often **do** you **have to** feed the cat? — Twice a day.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza, mushukka necha marta **ovqat berishing kerak**? — Kuniga ikki marta.

sentences.text: **Does** your brother **have to** do military service? — Yes, next year.
sentences.translation: Akangiz harbiy xizmatni **o'tashi kerakmi**? — Ha, kelasi yil.

examples.title: **have to** ↔ **don't have to**
examples.description: Zarurat va uning yo'qligi yonma-yon: **have to** — «shart», **don't have to** — «shart emas». Ish va dam olish kunlari, turli joylardagi qoidalar.

sentences.text: On weekdays I **have to** get up at six, but on Sundays I **don't have to**.
sentences.translation: Ish kunlari soat oltida **turishim kerak**, yakshanba kunlari esa **shart emas**.

sentences.text: In Britain you **don't have to** carry an ID card, but in some countries you **have to**.
sentences.translation: Britaniyada shaxsiy guvohnoma olib **yurish shart emas**, ba'zi davlatlarda esa **shart**.

sentences.text: Madina **has to** work on Saturdays, but her husband **doesn't have to**.
sentences.translation: Madina shanba kunlari **ishlashi kerak**, eri esa **ishlashi shart emas**.

sentences.text: Pupils **have to** wear a uniform at school, but students **don't have to** wear one at university.
sentences.translation: O'quvchilar maktabda forma **kiyishi shart**, talabalar esa universitetda **kiyishi shart emas**.

sentences.text: Tom **doesn't have to** pay rent — he lives with his parents — but he **has to** help with the shopping.
sentences.translation: Tom ijara **to'lashi shart emas** — u ota-onasi bilan yashaydi — lekin xarid qilishda **yordam berishi kerak**.

sentences.text: We **had to** queue for an hour last time, but today we **didn't have to** wait at all.
sentences.translation: O'tgan safar bir soat **navbatda turishga majbur bo'lgandik**, bugun esa umuman **kutishimizga to'g'ri kelmadi**.

sentences.text: You **have to** book a table at that restaurant on Fridays; on Mondays you **don't have to**.
sentences.translation: U restoranda juma kunlari stol **band qilish kerak**; dushanba kunlari esa **shart emas**.

sentences.text: Sorry, I **have to** finish this report tonight. — You **don't have to** finish it tonight; Friday is fine.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu hisobotni bugun kechqurun **tugatishim kerak**. — Bugun **tugatishingiz shart emas**, juma kuni ham bo'laveradi.

sentences.text: In summer Grandma **has to** water the garden every evening; in winter she **doesn't have to**.
sentences.translation: Yozda buvim har kecha bog'ni **sug'orishi kerak**, qishda esa **shart emas**.

sentences.text: With a British passport you **don't have to** get a visa for Uzbekistan, but you **have to** register at your hotel.
sentences.translation: Britaniya pasporti bilan O'zbekistonga **viza olish shart emas**, lekin mehmonxonada **ro'yxatdan o'tish shart**.

examples.title: **must** or **have to**?
examples.description: **must** — so'zlovchining o'z fikri, ichki zarurat; **have to** — tashqi sabab: qoida, ish, boshqa odam. O'tmishda ikkalasi ham — **had to**.

sentences.text: I **must** call Grandma — I haven't spoken to her for a week.
sentences.translation: Buvimga **qo'ng'iroq qilishim kerak** — bir haftadan beri u bilan gaplashmadim.

sentences.text: I **have to** call the bank — they've blocked my card.
sentences.translation: Bankka **qo'ng'iroq qilishim kerak** — kartamni bloklab qo'yishibdi.

sentences.text: This book is amazing; you **must** read it!
sentences.translation: Bu kitob ajoyib; uni albatta **o'qishing kerak**!

sentences.text: For the course, students **have to** read five books.
sentences.translation: Kurs uchun talabalar beshta kitob **o'qishi shart**.

sentences.text: My doctor says I **have to** stop smoking.
sentences.translation: Shifokorim chekishni **tashlashim kerak**, deyapti.

sentences.text: I really **must** do more exercise — I feel so unfit.
sentences.translation: Ko'proq **sport bilan shug'ullanishim kerak** — o'zimni juda bo'shashgan his qilyapman.

sentences.text: We **have to** leave the hotel room by twelve — that's the rule.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona xonasini soat o'n ikkigacha **bo'shatishimiz kerak** — qoida shunday.

sentences.text: We **must** visit Sarah soon — she's all alone in her new flat.
sentences.translation: Tez orada Saranikiga **borishimiz kerak** — u yangi kvartirasida yolg'iz.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **has to** be at work by eight because her boss is very strict.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza soat sakkizgacha ishda **bo'lishi shart**, chunki boshlig'i juda talabchan.

sentences.text: Yesterday I **had to** take a taxi, because I missed the last bus.
sentences.translation: Kecha taksiga **o'tirishga majbur bo'ldim**, chunki oxirgi avtobusga ulgurmadim.

examples.title: **don't have to** ↔ **mustn't**
examples.description: Inkorda ma'no butunlay boshqa: **don't have to** — «shart emas» (xohlasangiz qiling), **mustn't** — «mumkin emas» (qilmang!).

sentences.text: You **don't have to** wear a jacket in this restaurant, but you **mustn't** wear shorts.
sentences.translation: Bu restoranda pidjak **kiyish shart emas**, lekin shorti **kiyish mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: After the injection you **mustn't** drive, but you **don't have to** stay in bed.
sentences.translation: Ukoldan keyin mashina **haydash mumkin emas**, lekin **yotishingiz shart emas**.

sentences.text: You **don't have to** answer every question in the test.
sentences.translation: Testdagi har bir savolga **javob berishingiz shart emas**.

sentences.text: You **mustn't** copy your friend's answers!
sentences.translation: Do'stingizning javoblarini **ko'chirmang**!

sentences.text: Bekzod **doesn't have to** come to the meeting; it's only for managers.
sentences.translation: Bekzod yig'ilishga **kelishi shart emas**: u faqat rahbarlar uchun.

sentences.text: Swimmers **mustn't** run near the pool — the floor is slippery.
sentences.translation: Suzuvchilar basseyn yonida **yugurmasligi kerak** — pol sirpanchiq.

sentences.text: We **don't have to** whisper — the library is empty.
sentences.translation: **Pichirlashimiz shart emas** — kutubxona bo'm-bo'sh.

sentences.text: Students **mustn't** use dictionaries during the exam, but they **don't have to** answer the questions in order.
sentences.translation: Imtihon paytida talabalarga lug'atdan **foydalanish mumkin emas**, lekin savollarga tartib bilan **javob berishlari shart emas**.

sentences.text: Mum, **do** I **have to** go to bed now? — No, you **don't have to**, but you **mustn't** be noisy.
sentences.translation: Oyi, hozir **yotishim kerakmi**? — Yo'q, **shart emas**, lekin **shovqin qilmagin**.

sentences.text: Guests **don't have to** leave the hotel early on Sunday, but they **mustn't** smoke in their rooms.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar yakshanba kuni mehmonxonadan erta **chiqib ketishi shart emas**, lekin xonalarda **chekish mumkin emas**.

examples.title: Dialogue: school rules in Tashkent and London
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: Emma va Dilnoza maktab qoidalarini solishtiradi — **have to**, **don't have to**, **had to**, **mustn't** va savollar.

sentences.text: — Dilnoza, **do** you **have to** wear a uniform at your school in Tashkent?
sentences.translation: — Dilnoza, Toshkentdagi maktabingizda forma **kiyishingiz shartmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, we **have to**. Boys **have to** wear dark trousers and a white shirt.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **shart**. O'g'il bolalar qora shim va oq ko'ylak **kiyishlari kerak**.

sentences.text: — It's the same here. But we **don't have to** wear a tie on Fridays.
sentences.translation: — Bizda ham shunday. Lekin juma kunlari galstuk **taqishimiz shart emas**.

sentences.text: — And you **mustn't** use phones in class, I suppose?
sentences.translation: — Darsda telefondan **foydalanish mumkin emas**, shundaymi?

sentences.text: — No, never. We **have to** leave them in our bags.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, hech qachon. Ularni sumkada **qoldirishimiz kerak**.

sentences.text: — How many hours **do** you **have to** study every day?
sentences.translation: — Har kuni necha soat **o'qishingiz kerak**?

sentences.text: — Six lessons, and then I **have to** do homework for two hours.
sentences.translation: — Oltita dars, keyin ikki soat uy vazifasi **qilishim kerak**.

sentences.text: — Last year I **had to** go to extra maths classes, too.
sentences.translation: — O'tgan yili qo'shimcha matematika darslariga ham **qatnashishga majbur bo'ldim**.

sentences.text: — Poor you! At least you **don't have to** study on Sundays, right?
sentences.translation: — Bechora! Hech bo'lmasa yakshanba kunlari **o'qishing shart emas**, to'g'rimi?

sentences.text: — Right, Sundays are free. But I **have to** help my mum at home!
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri, yakshanba bo'sh. Lekin uyda oyimga **yordam berishim kerak**!
